description:
Open a support ticket

Creates a support ticket on behalf of the authenticated account and returns its identifier. The ticket starts in state `open`, and `category` and `priority` fall back to `other` and `medium` when they are not given. Put everything a human needs into `description`: error messages, the identifiers involved and the steps that led to the problem, since the first reply is written by a person reading exactly this text. Creating a ticket also emits the `ticket.created` outbound webhook event to any endpoint subscribed to it.

body.description: The subject line and the full description, plus the optional `category` and `priority`. `category` groups the ticket by functional area and `priority` sets how urgently it is picked up.

category.description: The functional area this ticket relates to.

description.description: Full details of the support request. Use this to provide context, error messages, or steps to reproduce.

priority.description: The urgency level. Urgent tickets are prioritized for immediate reseller/admin attention.

subject.description: A concise summary of the issue or request.
